name: dianjing-app
description: 点睛 Dianjing —— AI 设计编辑器（基于 OpenPencil fork 自主演进）
author: another-momo & Dianjing contributors

scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run lint && vite build
scripts.lint: bun run lint:structure && oxlint -c oxlint.json --type-aware --type-check src/ packages/scene-graph/src/ packages/core/src/ packages/vue/src/ packages/dom-css/src/ packages/pen/src/ packages/kiwi/src/ packages/fig/src/
scripts.lint:structure: oxlint -c oxlint.json vite.config.ts vite/ .storybook/ src/ packages/scene-graph/src/ packages/scene-graph/scripts/ packages/core/src/ packages/vue/src/ packages/dom-css/src/ packages/dom-css/tests/ packages/dom-css/scripts/ packages/pen/src/ packages/pen/scripts/ packages/kiwi/src/ packages/kiwi/tests/ packages/kiwi/scripts/ packages/fig/src/ packages/fig/tests/ packages/fig/scripts/ tests/ scripts/ tools/
scripts.format: oxfmt --write .oxfmtrc.json vite.config.ts vite/ .storybook/ src/ packages/scene-graph/src/ packages/scene-graph/scripts/ packages/core/src/ packages/vue/src/ packages/dom-css/src/ packages/dom-css/tests/ packages/dom-css/scripts/ packages/pen/src/ packages/pen/scripts/ packages/kiwi/src/ packages/kiwi/tests/ packages/kiwi/scripts/ packages/fig/src/ packages/fig/tests/ packages/fig/scripts/ tests scripts/ tools/
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check .oxfmtrc.json vite.config.ts vite/ .storybook/ src/ packages/scene-graph/src/ packages/scene-graph/scripts/ packages/core/src/ packages/vue/src/ packages/dom-css/src/ packages/dom-css/tests/ packages/dom-css/scripts/ packages/pen/src/ packages/pen/scripts/ packages/kiwi/src/ packages/kiwi/tests/ packages/kiwi/scripts/ packages/fig/src/ packages/fig/tests/ packages/fig/scripts/ tests scripts/ tools/
scripts.check: bun run build:packages && bun run lint && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:vue && bun run check:i18n && bun run check:zones && bun run check:bindings && bun run check:deps && bun run check:audit && bun run check:secrets && bun run check:monorepo && bun run check:arch && bun run check:jsx-doc && bun run test:type-shapes && bun run test:tools && bun run test:dupes
scripts.check:quick: bun run format:check && bun run lint && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:zones
scripts.test:unit:quick: bash -lc 'mapfile -t test_files < <(bun tools/unit-tests/src/list.ts all); bun test "${test_files[@]}"'
scripts.test:unit:heavy: bash -lc 'mapfile -t test_files < <(bun tools/unit-tests/src/list.ts all --heavy-only); bun test --timeout 180000 "${test_files[@]}"'
scripts.test:dupes: jscpd packages/scene-graph/src packages/pen/src packages/core/src packages/dom-css/src src --min-lines 5 --min-tokens 50 --format typescript --threshold 0
scripts.build:packages: bun --filter @open-pencil/scene-graph build && bun --filter @open-pencil/pen build && bun --filter @open-pencil/kiwi build && bun --filter @open-pencil/fig build && bun --filter @open-pencil/core build && bun --filter @open-pencil/dom-css build && bun --filter @open-pencil/vue build
scripts.smoke:pi: bun spikes/s-pi/backend-smoke/t22/target-smoke.mjs && bun spikes/s-pi/backend-smoke/t22/history-smoke.mjs && bun spikes/s-pi/backend-smoke/t23/sessions-smoke.mjs && bun spikes/s-pi/backend-smoke/t24/prompt-assembly-smoke.mjs && bun spikes/s-pi/backend-smoke/t28/session-gc-smoke.mjs && bun spikes/s-pi/backend-smoke/t87/skill-toggle-smoke.mjs
scripts.package:dir: bun run build:packages && vite build && bun run spike:sidecar:build && bun run spike:electron:build && bun run stage:native-externals && ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ bunx electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: bun run notices:generate && bun run build:packages && vite build && bun run spike:sidecar:build && bun run spike:electron:build && bun run stage:native-externals && ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ bunx electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
